excerpt: Read Ajman's latest reported transaction and rental activity alongside the risks that could shape an individual property decision in 2027.
introduction:
Ajman's 2027 property outlook begins with active but uneven evidence: the emirate reported real estate transactions worth more than AED 10.8 billion in the first half of 2026, while a later monthly release recorded AED 1.9 billion in September. These totals cover several kinds of transactions; they do not tell us that apartment prices or rents will rise in 2027.

The figures below were checked on 8 November 2026 and describe the periods stated. They are historical observations, not forecasts. Use them to frame questions about the exact property, its likely occupier and the costs of holding it.
takeaways: Ajman's published transaction totals include different transaction types and should not be treated as a house-price index.
Emirate-wide activity and a project's trading rank do not establish the return or availability of a specific apartment.
For 2027, compare current unit-level evidence and test vacancy, repairs, financing and resale assumptions.

sections.heading: What do the latest transaction figures say?
sections.body:
The Ajman Department of Land and Real Estate Regulation, reported by [Emirates News Agency for the first half of 2026](https://www.wam.ae/article/c17u7nm-ajman-real-estate-transactions-reach-aed108), recorded 6,815 real estate transactions with a total value exceeding AED 10.8 billion. It separately reported 5,435 trading transactions worth AED 7.64 billion and 969 mortgage transactions worth more than AED 1.88 billion. The aggregate is not limited to apartments or to completed residential sales.

The [September 2026 release](https://www.wam.ae/en/article/c2lumpg-ajman-real-estate-transactions-hit-aed19-billion) reported 1,143 transactions worth AED 1.9 billion, including 879 trading transactions worth AED 1.44 billion and 153 mortgages worth AED 207 million. The chart displays reported amounts for the same month. The categories sit within the wider transaction total and should not be added to it.

A later [third-quarter valuation report](https://www.wam.ae/en/article/c2zjm1r-real-estate-valuation-transactions-ajman-reached), issued on 29 October, recorded 738 valuation transactions worth over AED 3.31 billion. Valuations are not completed sales and the report includes commercial property. A few large land or commercial deals can affect an aggregate, so none of these totals is a like-for-like measure of a particular home. September is one month and H1 is six months; compare consistent periods and definitions before drawing conclusions about a trend.

sections.heading: What can rental registrations tell an investor?
sections.body:
Ajman Municipality and Planning Department reported approximately AED 2.91 billion across 73,472 registered rental contracts in the first half of 2026, according to [Emirates News Agency](https://www.wam.ae/en/article/c1s2ymi-ajman-rental-contracts-valued-aed291-billion-first). That is evidence of contract activity across the reported market, not an average apartment rent, a measure of occupancy in a particular tower or a guaranteed future yield.

A prospective landlord needs much narrower evidence: the rent actually achieved for comparable apartments, the dates of those leases, building charges, condition and the time units spend vacant. An asking rent is useful context but can differ from the signed rent. Check whether a comparable is furnished, has parking or includes a utility, and use the same assumptions when comparing buildings.

Net operating income is rent actually received less vacancy and relevant operating expenses. Divide that figure by the full acquisition cost to estimate an unleveraged net yield. A mortgage payment and capital repayment belong in a separate cash-flow calculation; the yield does not promise either occupancy or appreciation.

sections.heading: Where should a buyer investigate competition?
sections.body:
In the H1 2026 release, Emirates City, City Towers and Ajman One were named among the most actively traded major projects. Al Helio 2, Al Helio 1 and Al Zahia were named among the active neighbourhoods. The September release again identified Emirates City among the most traded projects. These are transaction-activity observations for the stated periods, not a ranking of investment returns or a recommendation for a particular unit.

Ask how much comparable supply exists in the building and nearby projects, what has actually been handed over and whether additional homes could compete for tenants. For a waterfront home, examine service charges, building maintenance and the specific view and access. For an established urban tower, check management, the condition of shared spaces and the lease evidence for the same layout.

The [Ajman area guide](/journal/ajman-property-2026) offers wider location context. Use it alongside an inspection and current local evidence, rather than treating every home in a named area as equivalent.

sections.heading: Which changes could matter during 2027?
sections.body:
Supply matters at the level of the buyer's chosen property type. An increase in similar completed apartments in the same catchment could give tenants and buyers more choice; a delay could alter the timing instead. Neither outcome is established by a promotional launch. Ask for independently verifiable construction progress, expected completions and the contractual consequences of delay.

Financing terms can change a buyer's cash requirement even when the asking price does not. Obtain a current lender illustration, including the rate after any introductory period and the bank's valuation assumptions. A property that depends on refinancing to pay a large future instalment needs a credible alternative if the bank does not approve it.

Household demand is another uncertainty. Consider the actual journey to work, the apartment layout and its affordability to the intended occupier. Demand across the emirate does not establish that a specific unit will be occupied continuously or resold quickly.

sections.heading: Check registration and the contract before paying
sections.body:
For a resale, request the title, the seller's authority, any existing mortgage or lease, the current service-charge position and the relevant clearance. The [Ajman sale-registration service](https://www.ajman.ae/en/servicecatalog/services/3162) describes its document process; confirm current charges for the exact transaction.

For an off-plan purchase, check project registration, the ownership right available to you, the payment recipient and the contract. Ajman's [development law](https://ajmanre.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/Amiri-Decree-No-2-2020.pdf) sets out the framework for off-plan development within its scope. Verify how it and any current rules apply to the project with the land department and a qualified adviser.

Build a contingency for a delayed handover, a change in financing or a repair. A high reported transaction total cannot compensate for an unsuitable contract or a unit you cannot afford to hold.

sections.heading: How to use this outlook in a shortlist
sections.body:
Review the [Aliyas Ajman project collection](/projects?emirate=Ajman), then request current unit availability, the exact specification and a written price. Compare at least two options against the same budget and objective. Compare the latest project terms alongside the market activity described in the earlier sections.

[Contact Aliyas](/contact) with your intended use, budget, financing position and preferred area to discuss the questions and current documents for your shortlist. Review the department's latest releases and your property quotations during 2027 alongside the 2026 data discussed here.
